tools.name: get_working_context
tools.description: Read the selected scope and workflow. Pass known_rules_hash only for retained rules.

tools.name: get_project_tree
tools.description: Read private folder IDs and tree_hash with an owner workspace token.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List only artifacts and projects available to this particular agent connection.

tools.name: list_design_contexts
tools.description: Discover reusable packs and references with the owner's workspace connection.

tools.name: get_design_context
tools.description: List current design references and source hashes without server filesystem paths.

tools.name: read_design_reference
tools.description:
Read up to 1 MiB from an inventoried private design file (up to 50 MB total).
Prefer compact guidance and examples first. For original binaries use
python -m artifact_studio.designs.download with the inventoried path/hash.

tools.name: get_design_file
tools.description: Read one author-editable design text file and its current hash.

tools.name: get_authoring_guide
tools.description: Load detailed authoring or host-hook guidance only when needed.

tools.name: get_agent_hook_client
tools.description: Get the optional stdlib hook client; respect native host installation and trust.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Read this artifact's manifest and brief, excluding private legacy discussion.

tools.name: read_artifact_files
tools.description: Read declared owned files, at most 1 MiB; revision=0 selects current source.

tools.name: get_presentation_outline
tools.description: Read this presentation's brief, slide order and current concurrency hashes.

tools.name: export_powerpoint
tools.description:
Get a PowerPoint download URL for the current presentation.

Save the binary with an HTTP file client using the same Studio Bearer token.

tools.name: read_presentation_brief_file
tools.description: Read a bounded page of an owner brief file listed by get_presentation_outline.

tools.name: get_slide
tools.description: Read complete slide source and expected_hash without other people's chat.

tools.name: get_slide_designs
tools.description: Read published design sets and human decisions for this slide.

tools.name: get_slide_design
tools.description: Read one frozen design's editable audience source.

tools.name: capture_slide_design
tools.description: Render a frozen slide design without changing the current slide.

tools.name: get_element_alternatives
tools.description: Read element option groups and human decisions for this slide.

tools.name: get_element_alternative
tools.description: Read an immutable element fragment in its retained full-slide context.

tools.name: capture_element_alternative
tools.description: Render a frozen element proposal in its full-slide context.

tools.name: get_deleted_slides
tools.description: List slide IDs and titles for recoverable deletions in an editable presentation.

tools.name: get_presentation_theme
tools.description: Read the presentation's author CSS and its current expected_hash.

tools.name: list_presentation_assets
tools.description: List this deck's asset paths, sizes and current replacement hashes.

tools.name: prepare_interactive_html
tools.description: Inline this deck's assets into interactive HTML without executing the supplied code.

tools.name: capture_slide
tools.description: Render actual audience pixels; excludes private discussion and speaker notes.

tools.name: capture_contact_sheet
tools.description:
Render 1–8 completed slides per scoped draft page; offset must be nonnegative.
Select up to 100 distinct slide IDs; use capture_slide for full-size detail.

tools.name: capture_artifact
tools.description: Render this owned artifact using the existing isolated browser capture.

tools.name: read_chat
tools.description:
Read assigned Shared threads or private Agent chat.

Owners can allow full Shared history on a presentation.

tools.name: read_chat_attachment
tools.description: Read a bounded page from an attachment visible to this scoped agent.

tools.name: read_feedback
tools.description:
Read pending requests with optional excerpts of prior Shared discussion.

Repeated excerpt IDs reference text included earlier in the response.
If shared_context_on_claim is true, claim with include_message=true for excerpts.
For collaborator_request_mode="suggest", use a proposal tool and reply with what
is ready for review. The connection cannot make direct edits in that mode.

tools.name: get_live_review_status
tools.description: Distinguish a requested connection from a host hook that is actually listening.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description:
Create a project/brief in the owned workspace; returns its ID and current tree_hash.
No request-ID deduplication: after a lost response, discover projects before retrying.

tools.name: create_project_folder
tools.description: Create a private folder using current tree_hash; an empty parent_id selects root.

tools.name: move_project_to_folder
tools.description: Place a project in a private folder using tree_hash; empty=root. No grant changes.

tools.name: revise_artifact
tools.description: Publish changed inline files with optimistic concurrency and an idempotent request ID.

files_json.description: JSON array of file changes with path and text, data_base64, or delete.
files_json.title: Files Json

tools.name: create_artifact
tools.description: Create an inline file bundle in an editable shared project; no host file paths.

tools.name: create_design_pack
tools.description: Scaffold a reusable HTML slide pack in the owner's selected workspace.

tools.name: write_design_file
tools.description: Save guidance, theme CSS or a text asset with its current design hash.

tools.name: attach_design_reference
revise_slide
tools.description: Edit one slide with the hash you read; conflicts must be re-read and reconciled.

tools.name: set_slide_activity
tools.description:
Show anonymous editing activity to deck readers. Refresh during work; clear when done.

Use only when you may share that work on this slide is in progress. Reading slides and
handling private feedback never publish this signal automatically.

tools.name: add_slide
tools.description: Add a slide to a shared presentation using the existing slide contract.

tools.name: create_presentation
tools.description:
Create a native deck with an initial cover and brief in your owned workspace.

A workspace connection can choose the project; a project connection defaults to its
project. Use a stable request_id to safely retry and include_content to read the cover.

FileInput.description: A local reference file attached to a brief or design request.
FileInput.title: FileInput

tools.name: import_powerpoint
tools.description:
Import a base64-encoded PPTX into an editable shared project.

Reuse request_id with the same payload to safely retry an import. Hosted MCP requests
are limited to 2 MiB; for larger files use scripts/import_powerpoint_mcp.py.

tools.name: reorder_slides
tools.description: Move slides using the previous order; include sections for cross-group moves.

DeckSection.description: A named, contiguous group of slides in the editing overview.
DeckSection.title: DeckSection

tools.name: publish_structure_proposal
tools.description: Request a human decision on a proposed presentation structure without editing it.

tools.name: set_presentation_sections
tools.description: Set named slide groups using the outline's slide order and sections hash.

DeckSection.description: A named, contiguous group of slides in the editing overview.
DeckSection.title: DeckSection

tools.name: restore_slides
tools.description: Restore a recoverable deletion using its operation_id and a stable request_id.

tools.name: publish_slide_designs
tools.description: Publish named whole-slide designs against get_slide's content_hash for human review.

DesignInput.description: A whole-slide direction; human notes and approval cannot be supplied.
DesignInput.title: DesignInput

Source.description: A source attached to a specific slide.
Source.title: Source

tools.name: publish_element_alternatives
tools.description: Publish alternatives for an existing static element, retaining its unique HTML ID.

ElementInput.description: One static replacement subtree, retaining the target's existing HTML id.
ElementInput.title: ElementInput

tools.name: update_presentation_context
tools.description: Replace the deck brief using context_hash from get_presentation_outline.

tools.name: update_presentation_theme
tools.description: Replace this presentation's author CSS using its current expected_hash.

tools.name: upload_presentation_asset
tools.description: Upload an inline deck asset; use its current sha256 when replacing existing bytes.

tools.name: claim_feedback
tools.description:
Claim or renew for 10 minutes with a stable session ID.

Set include_message=false after reading the task.

tools.name: reply_to_feedback
tools.description: Reply in the request's original channel and acknowledge the claimed task atomically.

tools.name: start_live_review
tools.description: Request this session's trusted host hook; does not disconnect other collaborators.

tools.name: stop_live_review
tools.description:
Pause only this native host session when finished; preserve collaborators and feedback.

Requires an updated trusted PostToolUse hook. Explicit start_live_review resumes review.

tools.name: remove_slide
tools.description:
Remove a slide the human asked to delete, preserving it for recovery.

Use expected_hash from get_slide. Reuse request_id to safely retry the same removal.
